name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx for three virtual hosts with static site roots, SSL-enabled sites, security headers, fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and logging, and applies cache-service configuration settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs the Python and PostgreSQL runtime, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, creates its database and user, configures the application environment, and runs it as a systemd service on port 8000.
